providers.title: Universal threshold repetition
providers.scope: Assume (S) (Song's conditioning estimate; not proved in the programme). For a finite game with entangled value v < 1, Pr[W_k >= ceil((v+delta)k)] <= exp(-kappa_0 delta^5 k/(1 + log d)) for every finite-dimensional strategy, with a universal kappa_0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Threshold repetition for a fixed question distribution
providers.scope: For a finite game with entangled value v < 1, Pr[W_k >= ceil((v+delta)k)] <= exp(-delta^3 k/(16384 (1 + kappa_mu)(1 + log d))) for every finite-dimensional strategy; kappa_mu depends on the support components of the question distribution.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One coordinate at a time
providers.scope: In every finite-dimensional strategy for the k-fold repetition, each coordinate is won with probability at most the entangled value.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sampling the upper tail
providers.scope: For arbitrary jointly distributed win indicators with Pr(W >= qk) = p_H > 0, some set C of at most ell coordinates is won with probability at least p_H q^ell/2 and, given that, W < q_0 k with probability at most epsilon.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From conditioning to threshold bounds
providers.scope: If conditioning cost at most T forces the average conditional win rate outside the tested set below v + delta/4, then the threshold probability is at most exp(-delta T k/(16(1 + log d))) for every k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two-sided error amplification
providers.scope: Assume (S). Accepting when at least ceil(tk) of k repetitions are won, with t the midpoint of the completeness and soundness levels, makes both errors exponentially small in k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Resolvent purification
providers.scope: The maps F_T h(s) = T(T+s)^(-1) h satisfy F_T^* F_T = T, and averaging effects moves them by at most the operator entropy gap of t log t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Transporting measurements
providers.scope: If F^* F = T and positive G_a sum to T, there is a POVM with F^* G~_a F = G_a for every answer a.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exact conditional laws
providers.scope: Conditional vectors and transported local measurements reproduce exactly the law of the answers at an untested coordinate given that all tested coordinates are won.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mixed exposure
providers.scope: Replacing one player's averaged effect by its average over the other player's question costs, on average over the untested coordinates, at most p tau in squared distance.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Drift under conditioning
providers.scope: For independent identically distributed coordinates and an event of probability p, the average total-variation distance of the conditional marginals from the original law is at most sqrt(log(1/p)/(2m)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conditioning through support components
providers.scope: The average conditional win rate outside a tested set is at most v + sqrt(log(1/p)/(2m)) + 4 sqrt(kappa_mu tau) + 2 kappa_mu tau.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
